name: ScoutRAG multilingual football retrieval training seed
labeling_method: Rule-authored German and English query specifications. Positives use typed identity, team, position, and source-comparable percentile evidence. Hard negatives are mined by embedding similarity inside a domain constraint.
limitations: This is a small portfolio training seed and not an independently annotated production dataset.
Metric examples are restricted to source-comparable profiles from the available StatsBomb partition.
The validation split tests unseen phrasings but can contain players that appear in another training concept.
Bayern examples train identity, team, and position language only because Bayern source coverage is partial.
A model improvement on this seed must not be generalized beyond the documented competition-season.
